subject: Current Gen6 field trace: coarse public 90 drives opening/handoff, then precise reacquisition falsely starts CLOSE/prewarm
body: FIELD+SOURCE CONFIRMED against current main 699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2 / field bundle duoopen-debug-1790957620826.zip. At uptime 133824109 DeviceState 0->1 remains folded=true. At 133825817 a PUBLIC_STANDARD 90.0 sample, resolution-classified coarse=true, is accepted reason=public-current. One ms later it drives NATIVE_COVER->OPENING_FROM_CLOSED generation=19; 78 ms later the same 90 drives INNER_HANDOFF generation=20. Samsung precise truth does not reacquire until uptime 133828543 (84.0), ~2726 ms after coarse acceptance. Because controller previous semantic angle is the bogus 90, the 90->84 delta is a STRONG_CLOSE_SAMPLE (>=5 deg), so the very first legitimate precise sample is interpreted as closing: INNER_HANDOFF->CLOSING_INTENT generation=21 and immediately ->COVER_PREWARMING generation=22, starting a cover lease during the opening attempt. Root source cause is Fold7AngleAuthority.offerPublic/promotePublic: once the 192 ms precise lease is absent/expired, a fresh public candidate is promoted regardless of candidate.coarse. HingeAngleSource then emits it as AuthoritativeSample; FoldOverlayService enqueues every authoritative sample into continuity semantic ingress without source/coarse filtering. This is not merely a UI angle-report issue; it can directly create cross-direction route churn. Recommended boundary: coarse public samples remain shadow-only and never enter continuous semantic geometry; independently corroborated 0/180 endpoint/rest evidence must use a separate explicit endpoint path. Fine public samples may remain eligible fallback. Preserve virtual/blind opening visual as visual-only. No production writes made.
